exposure: Marfan syndrome with aortic root dilation ≥40 mm
Marfan syndrome without aortic root dilation ≥40 mm
increasing aortic root diameter during pregnancy
cohort: 31 pregnancies in 19 women with Marfan syndrome who attended a cardiology high-risk pregnancy clinic between 2006 and 2015
finding: Pregnant patients with Marfan syndrome, especially those with a dilating aortic root, are at high risk of aortic dissection, but maternal and neonatal outcomes are generally good with appropriate management.
mod_finding: All high-risk women with MS gave birth by cesarean section, whereas in the non-high-risk group mode of delivery was by obstetric indication.
